Initial model schema rejected by provider; eight failures retained, followed by explicit nullable source fields.
Subsequent real responses copied old measurements or proposed unrelated state; hard validation preserved the project. Final focused tip response contract rejects unrelated fields structurally.

Initial automatic approval review blocked external testing before any request. Prepared public/synthetic payload review and explicit existing user authorization supported the normal approved reattempt.
A full-source CAD fixture initially omitted profile_id and failed before export; corrected fixture then completed actual export.
limits: Only two reviewed commercial profiles and the declared-dimension holder on Jubilee are supported.

Unknown current price, stock, pack identity and total printing cost remain unknown.

No new dependency, physical test, purchase, event submission or video edition is part of this feature release.
